name: indiAccounting
tagline: Double-entry accounting and payroll for small business
blurb: indiAccounting is a complete double-entry accounting and payroll application for small businesses, with a native desktop interface.
description:
indiAccounting is a complete double-entry accounting and payroll application
for small businesses, with a native desktop interface. It keeps a real
general ledger behind the scenes, so your invoices, bills, and payroll all
flow into proper financial statements — no spreadsheets, no monthly fees.

Features include:

• Invoices and estimates, with customer payments and recurring invoices

• Sales orders, invoiced all at once or in stages as goods ship

• Bills, vendor payments, and purchase orders with receiving

• Accrual-basis double-entry general ledger and manual journal entries

• Close a period so filed figures stay frozen, with corrections posting as reversing entries

• Payroll with federal and all-50-state withholding, FICA, FUTA, SUTA, and prevailing-wage / certified payroll

• Sales tax tracking by jurisdiction, reporting, and filing

• Inventory and product/service catalog

• Bank statement import and reconciliation

• Financial reports: profit and loss, balance sheet, trial balance, cash flow, A/R and A/P aging, and general ledger — plus a custom report builder and per-job profitability

• 1099-NEC vendor reporting and W-2 payroll forms

• Budgets with budget-vs-actual

• Mileage and time tracking

• Late fees, payment reminders, and customer statements

• CSV import and export, and PDF invoices and estimates

• Receipt capture with OCR (text extraction) and document attachments

• Local database backup and restore

indiAccounting respects your privacy and works entirely offline. Your
company's books are stored in a local file on your own computer and never
leave your machine.
